name: Screen focus
author: knicefire
description: This screen's workspace number, marked when the screen has focus

barWidget.description: This screen's workspace number, marked when the screen has focus

schema.label: Hide with one screen
schema.description: Hide the widget while only one monitor is connected, since there is nothing to distinguish.

schema.label: Unfocused dim (%)
schema.description: Extra fade on screens that are not focused. The number is already drawn in the theme's muted colour there; 100 leaves it at that.

schema.label: Badge width
schema.description: Width of the badge behind the number, before the spacing scale.

schema.label: Badge height
schema.description: Height of the badge. The horizontal bar is 26px tall, so keep some room.

schema.label: Badge corner
schema.description: Corner radius. Half the height gives a full stadium; less gives a rounded rectangle.
